Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 15IRH10 Performance Laptop (Intel Core i7-13620H / 16GB RAM / 512GB NVMe SSD / 15.6 Inch FHD Display / Luna Grey Edition / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Experience seamless multi-tasking capabilities and high-speed processing efficiency with the Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 15IRH10 Laptop, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a comprehensive 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. This slim profile system is powered by the high-performance 13th Generation Intel Core i7-13620H processor matrix, built to handle heavy office tasks, academic projects, and media streaming effortlessly. Equipped with a generous 16GB of high-density memory alongside an ultra-fast 512GB NVMe PCIe solid-state storage framework, it offers instant system boot times and rapid data tracking access. The laptop showcases a beautiful 15.6 Inch Full HD display layout framed by narrow bezels to maximize screen real estate for immersive media playback. Finished in a premium minimalist Luna Grey chassis with a comprehensive array of modern input-output connectivity paths and long-lasting battery execution parameters, this device delivers premium productivity without any extra clutter.
